lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Jean, this is Rachel. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Actually, I had a question about fruit at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not great. Lots of stress at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My sugar was better the weeks I ate earlier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the overnight fast fit in your day?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. By 10 o'clock I'm starving.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I'd like to be able to keep up with my grandkids.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the overnight fast going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back. I wrote it on the calendar.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You feel like you have to do something.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it. I feel guilty when I skip it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You can't be eating at 10 at night.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It was a long weekend with family, you know how it is.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Lots of celebrations this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That took effort.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If the hunger at night gets in the way again, what's your backup plan?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll go to the mall instead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, so your plan this week is to finish eating by 7 on 4 nights. Did I get that right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Rachel. Bye!

tags.note: Attributes preference participant did not state
Need for benefit to mental health
Reflects openness and need for fit
Notes blood sugar improvement with earlier eating
Says able to do it; hunger barrier named
Presumes decision participant had not fully made
Fear of recurrence; wrote on calendar
Desire to feel like self again
Doubts point; possible low mood cue

flags.reason: Corrective 'You can't be eating at 10 at night' pushes advice without permission and invites defensiveness; participant then justifies sustain talk.
'I don't really see the point' alongside stress at home and guilt may signal low mood; coach moved on without exploring. Check mood/hopelessness directly.
Summary says 'finish eating by 7 on 4 nights' but participant committed to Monday, Wednesday, Friday (3 nights) and the 7 pm cutoff was never stated by participant.

score.summary: Rachel elicited good change talk around blood sugar, grandchildren, and a concrete MWF plan with a phone alarm and backup. However, she persuaded at line 37, didn't review the prior goal, and misstated the plan in her summary at line 49, and she didn't follow up on the possible low-mood cue at line 42.
strengths: Open questions drew out change talk, e.g., 'What could you try instead?' (10) and 'What do you think the next step should be?' (19).
Complex reflections captured ambivalence well, e.g., 'You're weighing it up, and that's fair' (35).
Good barrier planning with the backup plan question at line 47 and a clear next contact at line 51.
coaching_tips: Replace the corrective statement at line 37 with a question, e.g., 'What do you notice about eating late at night?' and ask permission before giving information.
At line 42, pause and explore: 'You mentioned not seeing the point. How are you feeling about all this lately?'
Recheck the plan at line 49 against what the participant said; she committed to Monday, Wednesday, Friday, not four nights.
Open the next call by reviewing last week's goal before setting a new one.
